programme.title: Gadar 2
programme.desc: Directed by Anil Sharma, Gadar 2 continues the saga of Tara Singh (Sunny Deol) and Sakeena (Ameesha Patel). Set against the backdrop of the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971, the film follows Tara's daring mission to save his imprisoned son, Jeete, blending intense action with emotional depth.

programme.title: Faltu
programme.desc: F.A.L.T.U (short for Fakirchand and Lakirchand Trust University) is a youth-centric comedy-drama that follows a group of friends who, after being rejected by traditional colleges, decide to invent their own fake institution to satisfy their parents. Unexpectedly, the college becomes popular among similarly “non-performing” students seeking a second chance. Starring Jackky Bhagnani, Riteish Deshmukh, and Arshad Warsi, the film is a commentary on India’s rigid education system and encourages thinking outside the box.

programme.title: Ek Aur Ek Gyarah
programme.desc: Directed by David Dhawan, this action-comedy features Govinda and Sanjay Dutt as conmen Tara and Sitara. Their escapades lead them to a military household, where they masquerade as patriots, resulting in a series of comedic events. The film combines slapstick humor with action-packed sequences.

programme.title: Double Dhamaal
programme.desc: Directed by Indra Kumar, this follow-up to Dhamaal reunites the original gang Ritesh Deshmukh, Arshad Warsi, Aashish Chaudhary, and Javed Jaffrey as they attempt to double-cross a slick businessman (Sanjay Dutt). With new additions Kangana Ranaut and Mallika Sherawat, the film delivers over-the-top antics and comedic twists.

programme.title: Kissa Ka Bhai Kissi Ki Jaan
programme.desc: Bhaijaan, the eldest brother of three siblings, refuses to get married to maintain harmony in his family. However, complications arise after his brothers conspire for him to fall in love.
